purpose: Prepare question-led simulation inputs using the official Figure 5 primary and approximate wider study levels

boundary.source: Official Theme B brief p.4 Figure5
boundary.interpretation: Solid primary + dashed approximate secondary, registered source-stroke traces; no operational block expansion or straight cuts
boundary.membership: Only original full footprints covered by the source outline enter building analysis; crossing and exterior models remain context

reusable: JMA 2025 hourly records and quality flags
geometry builders and native heat-budget diagnostics
existing acceptance criteria as recorded project screens
rebuild: complete surrounding geometry and coverage audit
street and facility inventory and denominators
wind-aligned air-domain bounds and inlet setup
energy estimates with the revised area/use groups

domain.cost_rule: Include each building whose distance from the revised evaluation area is less than 6 times its own height; assess uncertain distant context by sensitivity.
domain.lateral_rule: case-dependent; assess a second boundary distance
domain.old_500_750m_and_5_15_5H: project choices, recompute rather than copy
domain.directions: define upstream/downstream per meteorological wind-from case
domain.public_mapping: One shared view: official solid primary + dashed approximate wider outline. Air domain is separate model metadata.

weather.new_cases: Select against the design question and source quality flags; no new selection fixed

dependencies: Use Figure 5 source scopes and report 25m boundary membership sensitivity
field geometry/vegetation and energy input gaps
fresh compute host selection before new jobs

sources.title: Official UMEP SOLWEIG manual
sources.supports: pedestrian radiation/Tmrt, surface/weather inputs and equal grid extent/pixel size

recomputation_rule: A reporting-mask-only change can reuse an accepted field after coverage checks. Current legacy fields are unaccepted. Select fresh solutions for the pilot when geometry or physical inputs change; do not automatically solve the entire district.

pilot.priority: Kajicho primary area near Kanda station; shortlist streets using food/service POIs, geometry and field checks. Specific pilot and intervention remain to be selected.

method_review.scope: reuse/rebuild rules, domain and H-rules, weather/heat/energy distinctions, historical acceptance and proposed checks

poi_context.use: Use function clusters to choose field-survey routes and candidate pilot streets in the primary area. POI counts do not determine physical heat or energy loads.
